title: New Arrivals: 15 Seductive Fragrances to Add to Your Collection
summary: This month's new arrivals bring 15 seductive fragrances together, from rich tobacco and warm gourmands to bright citrus florals and woods.
body_markdown:
Looking for a new scent that will have people turning their heads? This month’s new arrivals feature picks for everyone, from creamy gourmands and rich tobacco blends to addictive florals. Whether you gravitate toward something warm and intimate or prefer something that makes a bold first impression, these[seductive fragrances](https://www.scentbird.com/blog/most-attractive-perfume/) are worth getting to know.


## Seductive Fragrances for Every Mood


What makes a fragrance seductive? Sometimes it’s the familiar warmth of a note like amber and vanilla; other times, it’s the unexpected combination of sweet and spicy notes. For other people, it’s a fresh floral or fruity composition that leaves just enough of an impression to make someone lean in a little closer.


This month’s arrivals explore different interpretations of sensuality, from comforting skin-like scents to confident, statement-making compositions. Here are 15 new fragrances to discover.


## Meet the New Arrivals


### [CHAMBRE 52 Tobacco Memories](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/chambre-52-tobacco-memories-102582682529938)


A rich, nostalgic blend, Tobacco Memories pairs the warmth of tobacco with the luxurious touches of saffron and iris. Sweet cherry and vanilla soften the smoky incense, creating an intimate fragrance with a melancholic edge.


**Key Notes:** Saffron, Morello Cherry, Tobacco Absolu, Incense, Vanilla


### [FABBRICA DELLA MUSA Opera Infernal](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/fabbrica-della-musa-opera-infernal-259366963773041)


Inspired by the passion of South America, this expressive fragrance embraces life’s most intense emotions. Bright bergamot and pineapple meet aromatic geranium, earthy Haitian vetiver and praline for a bold contrast of freshness and sweetness. It naturally suits those with a larger-than-life personality.


**Key Notes:** Calabrian Bergamot, Pineapple, Egyptian Geranium, Haitian Vetiver, Praline


### [ESSENTIAL PARFUMS Fig Infusion](https://www.scentbird.com/shop/the-edit)


Fig Infusion brings a fresh, green sweetness to the skin, opening with juicy fig, mandarin, and clementine (yum). Floral notes of freesia and orange blossom meet black tea before settling into a creamy base of cedarwood and sandalwood.


**Key Notes:** Fig, Mandarin, Orange Blossom, Black Tea, Sandalwood


### [ESSENTIAL PARFUMS Nice Bergamote](https://www.scentbird.com/shop/the-edit)


Sunny and uplifting, Nice Bergamote opens with sparkling Calabrian bergamot before revealing a delicate floral heart of rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang. Cedarwood and tonka bean add a gentle warmth to this sunny, sophisticated scent.


**Key Notes:** Bergamot, Rose, Jasmine, Ylang Ylang, Cedarwood


### [ESSENTIAL PARFUMS Ambre Latte](https://www.scentbird.com/shop/the-edit)


For lovers of cozy gourmand fragrances, Ambre Latte blends creamy almond milk with roasted tonka bean and golden caramel. Vanilla and sandalwood round out the composition, leaving behind a soft, subtly addictive trail.


**Key Notes:** Almond Milk, Tonka Bean, Caramel, Vanilla, Sandalwood


### [LAURA GELLER Tuscan Sun](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/laura-geller-tuscan-sun-26766270298304)


This perfume perfectly captures the easy warmth of an Italian summer, with bright citrus and creamy florals setting a relaxed, sunny mood from the first spritz. A comforting blend of woods, amber and vanilla gives the fragrance a soft, golden finish.


**Key Notes:** Bright Citrus, Creamy Florals, Woods, Amber, Vanilla


### [NAVITUS XO Brandy](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/navitus-parfums-xo-brandy-233152497459299)


Rich and indulgent, XO Brandy combines fruity dates and almond with an intriguing brandy accord. African coffee absolute, heliotrope and cedarwood add depth, while cane sugar and sandalwood create a smooth, subtly sweet finish.


**Key Notes:** African Almond, Brandy Accord, African Coffee Absolute, Date Fruit, Cane Sugar


### [NAVITUS Vivamor](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/navitus-parfums-vivamor-256502520592869)


A celebration of life and love, Vivamor balances invigorating citrus and tropical fruit with a touch of spice. Pink peppercorn, lemon and pineapple lead into a deeper combination of rosewood, patchouli and dark amberwoods.


**Key Notes:** Pink Peppercorn, Pineapple, Lemon, Rosewood, Dark Amberwoods


### [NAVITUS Bake Me Happy](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/navitus-parfums-bake-me-happy-98032853126621)


A deliciously unexpected gourmand, Bake Me Happy opens with juicy blueberries, oats and nectarine before introducing a distinctive freshly baked bread accord. Roasted pistachios, vanilla butter, sandalwood and tonka make the dry-down especially cozy and irresistible.


**Key Notes:** Blueberries, Oats, Bread Accord, Vanilla Butter, Roasted Pistachios


### [SRHY: 71. SERIES A](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/srhy-71.-series-a-12901439352826)


71. SERIES A pays tribute to the first step toward a 20-year-old dream. A sophisticated combination of bergamot and peach meets leather, amber and vanilla for a fragrance that balances fruity brightness with a warm, sensual finish.


**Key Notes:** Bergamot, Peach, Leather, Amber, Vanilla


### [SUPERSUITE Gimmie Flowers](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/supersuite-gimmie-flowers-150672414727013)


Gimmie Flowers is a playful floral fragrance made for those who love making an entrance. Lush gardenia and orange flower mingle with bergamot, coconut and watery fruity notes for a bright, feel-good composition.


**Key Notes:** Gardenia, Orange Flower, Bergamot, Coconut, Water Fruits


### [SUPERSUITE Pear Skin](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/supersuite-pear-skin-209756034422794)


Fresh, fruity and effortlessly wearable, Pear Skin opens with the juicy sweetness of pear and mandarin. Transparent jasmine and soft musk bring a delicate quality to the fragrance, while cedarwood adds a clean, woody finish.


**Key Notes:** Pear, Transparent Jasmine, Musk, Cedarwood, Mandarin


### [SUPERSUITE Caramel Temptress](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/supersuite-caramel-temptress-217478775169080)


Caramel Temptress leans into its gourmand side with a decadent combination of caramel and vanilla. Jasmine and sandalwood add a floral, creamy dimension, while a warm bourbon accord gives the fragrance its irresistible edge.


**Key Notes:** Caramel, Jasmine, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Bourbon Accord


### WHAT WE DO IS SECRET Messy Sexy Just Rolled Out of Bed


With a name that says it all, Messy Sexy Just Rolled Out of Bed captures the appeal of an effortlessly intimate fragrance. Juicy peach and peach blossom meet bergamot and Turkish rose, while amber and tonka bean create a soft, lingering warmth.


**Key Notes:** Peach Blossom, Bergamot, Turkish Rose, Amber, Tonka Bean


### ĀNTI BAST ānti


Inspired by the ancient Egyptian perfume known as ânti, this fragrance reimagines a historic aromatic blend with a mysterious, modern edge. Frankincense and myrrh create a resinous foundation, while cardamom and amber add warmth and an intriguing touch of spice.


**Key Notes:** Frankincense Essence, Cardamom, Myrrh Essence, Amber


## Find Your Next Signature Scent


From smoky tobacco and warm amber to creamy gourmands and fresh florals, this month’s new arrivals offer something for every fragrance mood. Ready to find your next obsession? Explore these scents and discover your next signature fragrance with Scentbird.


## Frequently asked questions


### What makes a fragrance feel seductive?


It often comes down to warmth, whether that’s amber, vanilla, tobacco, or an unexpected sweet-and-spicy combination. Other seductive fragrances lean fresh and floral instead, built to leave just enough of an impression to draw someone closer.


### What’s a good seductive fragrance for someone who prefers gourmands?


Ambre Latte, with its creamy almond milk, tonka bean, and golden caramel, or Bake Me Happy, with its fresh-baked bread and vanilla butter accord, are both strong picks for gourmand lovers.


### Which new arrival is best for an evening out?


Tobacco Memories, with its saffron, cherry, and incense base, or Messy Sexy Just Rolled Out of Bed, with its peach and Turkish rose warmth, both lean toward an intimate, evening-appropriate character.


### What’s a lighter, fresher option in this month’s arrivals?


Nice Bergamote and Pear Skin both stay on the brighter, fresher end, built around bergamot and pear respectively, rather than the warmer gourmand and tobacco notes featured elsewhere in the list.


### How can I try these new fragrances before buying a full bottle?


Scentbird sends an 8 mL vial each month, which gives you enough time to wear a new arrival and see how it develops on your skin before committing to a full-size bottle.
